Let’s make sure our families know about every available resource. The City and County of Honolulu is offering the CARES Sewer Bill Credit, providing up to $240 in relief ($20/month equivalent) for eligible residential customers. This is a meaningful way to offset household costs. The deadline to apply is October 31! Who is eligible? ✅ You must receive residential sewer service from the Honolulu Board of Water Supply (BWS). ✅ The claimed property must be your principal residence. ✅ You must be current on your sewer payments. ✅ Your 2025 total annual gross household income must be at or below 80% of the Area Median Income (AMI). (Check the table in the image for the exact limits for your family size!) Even if this program doesn’t apply to your household, please take a moment to SHARE this post with a friend, neighbor, or family member who might benefit. To check your eligibility or find application details for the ENV Customer Assistance for Residential Environmental Services (CARES) financial assistance program: 🔗honolulu.gov/env/cares/ ☎️ 808-768-3330
